scope_decision.approved_scope: Only the four exact modern personal names and published ordinary Mandarin readings enumerated here, in their captured professional Go context, including the Taiwan-published forms. No pronunciation is selected from nationality, residence, or Han glyphs alone.
scope_decision.pinyin_classification: Independent linguistic determination for the actual complete published strings. It does not label all English columns or a publisher-wide romanization policy as Hanyu Pinyin.
scope_decision.not_allowed: English aliases, incomplete surname-only romanization, unresolved regional or reading variants, inferred Han readings, historical Sino-Korean reading substitution, or generic transliteration.
scope_decision.conventional_name_priority: Any reliable same-person Korean publication remains prior to generation; no global absence claim. One same-owner community ranking hit is retained below as reference agreement.
scope_decision.display_spacing: Join surname and given name for this project while preserving both boundaries in evidence; no special NIKL Chinese-name spacing mandate is asserted.
scope_decision.existing_owner_and_four_physical_name_pr: Accepted as the task input; not independently requalified against a current DB by this source-only review.

approved_inputs.reading_determination: The actual Taiwan Kiin profile pairs 黃家胤 and the complete English-name field Huang Jia-Yin in one paragraph. For this exact Han/Latin pair, huang + jia + yin is a complete ordinary Mandarin sequence directly compatible with Hanyu Pinyin; Jia-Yin publishes both given-name boundaries. The hyphen is preserved as a declared separator before normalization. No pronunciation or syllable is supplied from Han alone. This is an independent linguistic classification of this spelling, not a claim that the page explicitly calls it Hanyu Pinyin or that every Taiwan Latin name uses Pinyin.
